Fat, SNF, paani aur milawat ke test: Fat, SNF, water and adulteration tests

Gawalon se aya doodh — subah aur shaam: Milk from milkmen — morning and evening

Ghanti mat bajayein, darwaze par rakh de: Don't ring the bell, leave it at the door…

Ghar delivery ka mahina-war hisaab — pri: Monthly home delivery account — print or WhatsApp
Ghar delivery wale customers — roz ki qu: Home delivery customers — daily quantity, route, rate and credit book

Har batch ka yield (kitna bana) dikhta h: Each batch shows its yield (how much was made) — if low, check the milk or the method.

Har payment: galle se cash, ya bank / Ja: Each payment: cash from the drawer, or from a bank / JazzCash account.
Hotel, chai wale — itna ya zyada lein to: Hotels, tea stalls — buying this much or more gets a lower rate at the counter automatically
In dino ki list me nahi aayenge; aakhri: Won't be in the list for these days; restarts by itself after the last day
Is tareeqe ka default account ho to us s: If this method has a default account, it comes from there; otherwise only a record is made

Jo badalna hai badlein — khata aur pichl: Change what you need — the credit book and past deliveries stay as they are
Jo doodh gawale se aata hai us par \"asa: Mark the milk that comes from milkmen as "Main milk" — collection and delivery stock run on it.

Jo log dukaan ko doodh dete hain unhe ya: Add the people who supply milk to the shop here.

List pehle se bani hui hai — koi naya gh: List already made — no new home

Naam, number, phone, CNIC ya gaon…: Name, number, phone, CNIC or village…
Naam, number, phone, pata ya area…: Name, number, phone, address or area…

Name, phone, village and rate per liter. If fat is higher, a bonus per point — added automatically at collection.
